Hashing and validation helpers for vinyl bstream pairs, dead, move, part, and zero padding blocks.

# Purpose
This C file implements validation and utility functions for `fd_vinyl_bstream` block data. The main functions, such as [`fd_vinyl_bstream_pair_test`](<#fd_vinyl_bstream_pair_test>), [`fd_vinyl_bstream_dead_test`](<#fd_vinyl_bstream_dead_test>), [`fd_vinyl_bstream_move_test`](<#fd_vinyl_bstream_move_test>), [`fd_vinyl_bstream_part_test`](<#fd_vinyl_bstream_part_test>), and [`fd_vinyl_bstream_zpad_test`](<#fd_vinyl_bstream_zpad_test>), check the layout and content of different block types. They verify control fields, sequence values, sizes, key and info fields, zero padding, and hash values. The [`fd_vinyl_bstream_pair_hash`](<#fd_vinyl_bstream_pair_hash>) function computes and stores the hashes used to protect pair blocks against corruption.

The file also provides small conversion helpers for block control style values. [`fd_vinyl_bstream_ctl_style_cstr`](<#fd_vinyl_bstream_ctl_style_cstr>) converts a style code to a string, and [`fd_cstr_to_vinyl_bstream_ctl_style`](<#fd_cstr_to_vinyl_bstream_ctl_style>) converts a string such as `"raw"` or `"lz4"` back to a style code. Overall, this file is part of the `fd_vinyl_bstream` support code and is used to test, verify, and describe block records in the vinyl binary stream format.
